_comment: Every setting the corpus stages use, in one place (corpus-build-plan-2026-10-04, Phase 0 item 13). Change here, never in code. Analysis settings (seed length, floors, grids) live in config/analysis_settings.json, written before the analysis, not here.

selection.duplicate_rule: same magazine; same volume+number, or same whole number in the same year, or same full date, or same cover month for magazines that are not more than monthly; year-only records never merge; the item with more pages is kept, the others are alternates

download.user_agent: pulp_fiction_corpus/1.0 (text-reuse study, KNU Digital Humanities Engineering Center; contact hkim1596@knu.ac.kr)

reading._comment: One reading worker per URL in servers. Each URL is a Surya inference server (vLLM container) started by hand on its own GPU — docs/corpus-run.md, 'The reading servers': port 8020 on GPU 0, 8021 on GPU 2, 8022 on GPU 3 when it is free. PULP_SURYA_SERVERS in the environment overrides this list at run time (the pastes build it from the servers that answer). On 4 October GPUs 0, 1 and 3 were full (other models; GPU 3 is Heejin's own) and GPU 2 empty; GPU 0 was given up by its other project the same evening. spawn_env is what a worker passes to Surya when servers is empty and Surya spawns its own server: VLLM_GPUS picks the card, VLLM_GPU_TYPE=h100 sizes the batches for an 80-97 GB card (surya's table has no entry for the RTX PRO 6000). A worker whose server stops answering waits for it and marks no issue failed.

assembly.cross_issue_pass: per magazine, after all its issues are assembled

quality_score.definition: share of a story's tokens that are dictionary words (config/words.txt)
